motor_cable.tip_identity_note: Four end-face centres measured from the locked motor mesh. STEP is uncoloured: their colour assignment is illustrative, not evidence of factory conductor ordering. Use manufacturer winding colours and continuity checks.
motor_cable.splice_note: TE 320559 manufacturer STEP AE, nominal 32.131 mm axial span / 5.6134 mm radial envelope. V6 drawing length 32.13 mm max is the rounded 1.265 inch value. STEP dimensions are not a finished-crimp tolerance or physical fit approval.
motor_cable.length_note: Factory 1 m cable is trimmed and rerouted in the assembly. Cut lengths in harness-geometry.json are CAD centreline plus stated termination allowance; physical first-article confirmation required. Vendor STEP cable geometry past Y=-70 is replaced; motor body and terminal housing are unchanged.
motor_cable.pigtail_wire: Alpha Wire 3057, 16 AWG stranded, 300 V; 2.3368 mm nominal OD, +/-0.0508 mm

brake.thermal_boundary: At 53 V and 10 ohm: 5.3 A / 280.9 W while on. At 50 C ambient and 85 C case target, combined case-to-ambient <=0.1246 C/W for continuous dissipation. Geometry is not a thermal rating.
